general.description: Mar'K'Rinn'Ra was the first k'rinn colony and is a local capitol, renowned for its sandy smaller continent. Many Irilia Rithai have made the months-long space voyage to settle it, establishing a de facto k'rinn-rith co-colony. It is however still under Council jurisdiction and will stay so under the agreement between Council and Irilia Clan.
general.bar: A crowd of K'Rinns mixed with a sizeable number of Rithai and a few other sentients from all the known universe
